mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device (device_code, device_name, device_type, location, status) VALUES (#{deviceCode}, #{deviceName}, #{deviceType}, #{location}, #{status})
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM device
AND (device_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR device_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE device SET status = #{status}, last_online_time = #{lastOnlineTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE device SET status = 'OFFLINE', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'ONLINE' AND (last_online_time IS NULL OR last_online_time < #{deadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
